about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.before: caBack = () -> { System.arraycopy(s_DFHCOMMAREA.bytes, 0, raw, 0, Math.min(raw.length, keep)); if (s_DFHCOMMAREA.beyond != null) { System.arraycopy(s_DFHCOMMAREA.beyond, 0, raw, keep, raw.length - keep); } typed.run(); };
survivors.after: caBack = () -> { System.arraycopy(s_DFHCOMMAREA.bytes, 0, raw, 0, Math.min(raw.length, keep)); if (s_DFHCOMMAREA.beyond != null) { System.arraycopy(s_DFHCOMMAREA.beyond, 0, raw, keep, raw.length + keep); } typed.run(); };
survivors.reason: inside if (raw != null) in runTask: COCRDSLC is a terminal screen transaction entered via transaction CR00 or XCTL and never LINKed, so task.linkArea() is null and the raw link area write-back is never registered

SEND-MAP response store into f3_WS_RESP_CD: with no planned faults planned5 is {0, 0} so both operands evaluate to 0; further, subsequent file read operations in p23 and p27 overwrite WS-RESP-CD before any read
CURDATE map field unpack: typed CURDATE is unpacked into f229_CURDATEI, but COCRDSLC never reads CURDATEI on any path; the field is display-only on screen CCRDSLA

CRDNAME map field unpack: typed CRDNAME is unpacked into f265_CRDNAMEI, but COCRDSLC never reads CRDNAMEI on any path; the cardholder name is a display-only output field populated from card file records

CRDSTCD map field unpack: typed CRDSTCD is unpacked into f271_CRDSTCDI, but COCRDSLC never reads CRDSTCDI on any path; the card status code is a display-only output field populated from card file records
ERRMSG map field unpack: typed ERRMSG is unpacked into f295_ERRMSGI, but COCRDSLC never reads ERRMSGI on any path; error messages are populated only to ERRMSGO on output
inside paragraph 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT (p27): COCRDSLC.cbl defines this paragraph but contains no PERFORM 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT statement anywhere; the entire paragraph is unreferenced dead code
inside paragraph SEND-LONG-TEXT (p29): COCRDSLC.cbl defines this paragraph but contains no PERFORM SEND-LONG-TEXT statement anywhere; the entire paragraph is unreferenced dead code
